action: Close FV-P04-T001 and declare the bounded Phase 04A Professional French Safe Rewriting Foundation technically complete.
reason: The approved slice is complete, scoped and fail-closed. The deterministic rewriter changes only spacing and punctuation; lexical and sensitive-token validation rejects content mutation; empty, invalid and failed outputs return the exact source transcript; cancellation propagates; existing target recapture and insertion protections remain intact. Focused tests pass 37/37, the Release build reports zero warnings and errors, the complete suite passes 71/71, and both bounded reviews report no blocker after repairs. This verdict closes Phase 04A only and does not claim completion of deferred Ollama-backed rewriting or additional profiles.
